scope: Retained public-API regression and source audit; no geometry repair or independent validation of all readiness-plan claims is asserted.

probe.expected: Each of two copper layers contains the exact point (999/1000, 3/100), since its squared distance from the authored radius-1 via center is 998901/1000000 < 1.
probe.actual: F.Cu returns Some(false); the assertion stops before querying B.Cu.
probe.provenance: Newly authored single-via KiCad fixture, exact rational independent oracle, public loader and containment APIs.
probe.replay: Copy source-circle-probe to a writable temporary directory, replace its two absolute dependency paths with the checked-out repository paths, and run cargo run --offline --manifest-path <temporary directory>/Cargo.toml. The retained lock and source identify the observed run; the offline dependency cache is required.

findings.detail: Via copper is constructed from circle_polygon(..., 48) with f64 source size/center; exact source location and drill metadata do not preserve the copper boundary.

Clearance metrics and threshold helpers consume projected rings. Lifting their dyadics exactly does not restore the source arcs. Failed candidate comparisons and missing distances can be discarded; downstream checks can continue without recording uncertainty.
exact_input_polygon_bounds derives bounds from report rings instead of each polygon authoritative region.
polygon_area_scalar falls back to report-ring shoelace if authoritative area is unavailable.
Area and bounds OnceLock<Option<_>> can retain unavailable results; resource-denial reproduction remains to be constructed.
If material-component extraction is unavailable, exact_backed_finite_polygons rebuilds Polygon::new from display rings. Projection failures use expect; component cache retains None.
